en: the Dhvajāgrakeyūrā Dhāraṇī. Homage to the Triple Gem!
Homage to the Blessed One, the Tathāgata, Arhat, Samyaksaṃbuddha Dhvajāgrarāja. It is thus:
Jaya jaya vijaya vijaya Jayavāhini saṃgari prabhañjani prabhañjani! Paralyze, paralyze all enemies; stun, stun; delude, delude! O Blessed One, Jayavāhini, crush, crush!

O Destroyer, O Destroyer! Swallow, swallow! Laugh, laugh! Hūṃ hūṃ! O Lambodarī, O Three-eyed One, O Four-faced One, O Four-mouthed One, O Four-tusked One, O Four-armed One, wielder of the sword, the club, the scimitar, the trident, and the thunderbolt—protect, protect me! O Blessed Lady, strike, strike! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Crush, crush! Destroy, destroy! Hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ! Shatter, shatter all enemies!
O you who stand upon the tip of the banner, O armlet-wearer, O Triṭa, O bearer of the firebrand! O Lord of the Three Worlds, destroy the enemy army!

Protect me, protect me! Move, move! Cili cili! Culu culu! Kala kala! Kili kili! Kulu kulu! Release the thunderous laughter! Destroy the enemy army! Confuse them! By the truth of the Buddha, by the truth of the Dharma, by the truth of the Saṅgha, by the truth of those who speak the truth—do not transgress the truth of the Buddha, do not transgress the truth of the Dharma, do not transgress the truth of the Saṅgha, [by] the truth...
O Debater, transgress the truth! O Lambodara, strike, strike, strike again, strike again! O Rudra, honor Viṣṇu; honor Candra and Sūrya;
honor the sovereignty of the three worlds; honor all the gods, all the yakṣas, rākṣasas, gandharvas, and kinnaras.
O Mahoraga, honor [us]! Destroy all our enemies! Rush! Rush! Cause them to rush! Blaze!
Blaze, O Puṣpamālinī! Lick! Lick! Triṭa! Triṭa! With a face of frowning brows, you who effect the destruction of the enemy armies—ha!
hi! hi! hu! hu! he! he! riṇi! riṇi! riṇā! O Mother, may victory be yours upon the banner!
Buddhāvalokite, protect, protect me, O Blessed One Avalokite, svāhā!
To all the planets, constellations, and astrological instruments, svāhā!
